'''Kerek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked as the chief enforcer of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaltho]]'s [[Kaltho's empire|criminal empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When Kaltho traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to bid on the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]], Kerek accompanied him to make the locals fear the Hutt's power. While in Cloud [[City/Legends|City]] Kerek moved between various locations where he could spread fear, including the ''[[Four-and-a-Half]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] however, was not overly loyal to Kaltho and was willing to provide information on his boss for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or information on a good bounty.<ref name="TJoY" />
{{RPG}}
A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] planning to manipulate the bidding for the jewel and then steal it contacted Kerek, and the hunter provided them with information on Kaltho that might aid them in their plan.<ref name="TJoY" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kerek first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. Players have the option of finding Kerek and gaining information on Kaltho from him, which this article assumes they successfully did.
